answer: The canyon schedule is applied in karst and tundra shows each instalment. A hostile operator thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 26% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2546 identities would post 3841 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
